_about: One-time moves of characters onto an account, run at the server's start (src/accounts.py apply_moves): onto the account of the character `to_account_of`, the characters named and (min_level) every one of at least that level, except those on skip_accounts; admin makes that account an admin one. Each id runs once (lib/moves_done.json); one whose account isn't there yet waits for a later start. Saves and accounts it changes are copied first to lib/backups/moves-<id>-<time>.

moves.why: the owner's own account (their bard Ibolt) holds all their characters, the end-game test ones too (asked for 2026-10-22); admin, so those immortal through the old admin account stay so. The gauntlet suites' Probe* characters stay on their accounts: the live tests sign in as them.
